name: ux-before-ui
description: The design method to run before drawing any screen, page or slide: purpose, audience, journey, jobs and how expert teams solve them, then every screen side by side, critique and a handoff.

interface.shortDescription: Think like a design team before you draw a single screen
interface.longDescription: Most AI-made interfaces start from three style words and go straight to screens. This plugin reverses the order: who arrives, in what state, wanting and fearing what; the journey and its moments of truth; the jobs ranked; how expert teams solve the same jobs, from real product screens. Then every screen, page or slide is drawn side by side, critiqued and handed off. Sized to the medium: app, site, landing page or deck.
defaultPrompt: Redesign our onboarding, people drop off after signup
Plan a landing page for our new product before we build it
Audit the UX of this app and propose a new structure
